answer: Quarantine every new agent in a harbor zone: fresh wallets transact only with established peers at tiny caps while auditors watch before full privileges unlock. Admission works like grafting a vine onto old rootstock: a sponsor co-signs the first tasks and stakes its own reputation, so one bad graft damages the vine it came from. Weight then climbs in a spiral of increasingly large attested rounds, each wider than the last, never a straight jump.
